summary: Frontend-only verification of iteration 3 (pointer fix, creator portraits, window sheen, dark finale, regressions). The reported 'stuck cursor' bug is FIXED: FakeCursor moves between real DOM targets, loops, and visibly triggers .cursorPress on data-cursor targets. All 5 chapters advance, portraits load from Unsplash with naturalWidth>0, window sheen transform changes as you scroll, appWindow gains .dark class on chapters 3-5 and closing section/footer render fully black with white text. Header switches to .onDark over the closing section. No console or page errors; no horizontal overflow on 1920x1080 or 390x844; fake cursor is correctly hidden on mobile.

issues: Computed color on <footer> element itself is rgb(10,10,11) on background rgb(5,5,6) - visually hidden if any direct text is rendered without an overriding color. Current children (POWERED BY CROWNED, links) override color so they stay readable, but any future direct footer text (copyright line, address) would disappear. Suggest setting footer base color to a light grey.

action_items: (Optional) Set a readable base text color on .footer.finale so future direct text is not rgb(10,10,11) on near-black.
critical_code_review_comments: Fake cursor correctly reads from .screen.active [data-cursor] targets and loops; movement verified across 6 samples (6 unique positions) within chapter 1, plus press class hits on targets 1, 2 and 3.

appWindow.dark remains applied at prog 0.90-0.98 (window stays sticky through finale). This is expected visually because the closing section is itself black, so the transition reads clean. If the requirement is a literal fade-out of the dark state after the film, the current implementation keeps class='appWindow dark' through the end of the sticky film - worth double-checking intent but not visually broken.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fake cursor verification pattern: scroll to progress ~0.26 (chapter 1 start) before sampling; before entering the film the cursor is parked at a static position which can be mistaken for 'stuck'. Sample getBoundingClientRect every ~1.5s for 6 samples - expect multiple unique positions and look for elements with class .cursorPress to confirm press feedback. Chapter progress markers: 0.26, 0.41, 0.56, 0.70, 0.85. Dark finale class appears from chapter 3 onward in this build. All portraits are remote Unsplash URLs (unsplash.com/photo-1506863530036-..., photo-1587668223851-...) and load with naturalWidth 400/240.
